description: Who bought and who sold a token in the last hour ($0.01): send an ERC-20 contract address (Base by default; also ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon), get the top buyers and sellers by net USD, each the wallet that signed the swap, with buys, sells, a label from the tracked pools (SMART_MONEY, PROFITABLE, UNPROFITABLE, UNTRACKED), an automated flag, unique wallets, top-10 buyer share and smart-money net flow. Use to see which wallets are buying or selling a token; for the aggregate flow use analyze_token, for one wallet's record get_wallet_profile.

chain.description: Chain of the token or pool: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon (solana where listed). Not the payment network

name: get_token_traders
